title: A reality check on renewables - David MacKay
summary: David MacKay's TEDxWarwick talk uses basic arithmetic to show how much land and energy renewables would need to power a country like the UK. It explains the limits of sustainable options and why they should still be pursued.
why: Cited in energy debates for its back-of-envelope scale of the transition and the land and storage limits of wind and solar.

quote.text: I found this ted talk on the feasibility of various renewable energy sources quite eye opening
